purpose: Inspect official Xiangtan/Yuhu registry and geospatial channels for anonymous public parcel polygons with stable native IDs, without using personal or certificate-bound records.
assessment: Hunan Natural Resources Department material states Xiangtan’s certificate QR flow can return the specific property’s cadastral map/house plan. That is certificate-bound access, not a public bulk endpoint. Hunan Tianditu’s official public resource list includes general map services and themes for schools, hospitals, scenic spots, villages and epidemic stations; the published list does not include cadastral parcel features. The local Yuhu map page timed out on an escalated anonymous request. No parcel geometry or exact-point query was obtained, so no absence or citywide claim is made.
registryAssessment: Official sources establish a local property-registration institution and services for cadastral map access within the certificate-linked property system. No public anonymous geometry access was verified.
